folders.coordination: Current manual coordination pointers and workflow diagram.

namingRules.versionFolders: Use explicit version folders such as v001, v002, v003.
namingRules.overwritePolicy: Do not overwrite or delete previous versions automatically.

securityRules: Do not store secrets or customer data.
Do not store passwords, API keys, tokens, private keys, or real connection strings.
Do not store full OBM source code in this coordination repository.
Reference binary artifacts by path, artifact ID, version, commit SHA, checksum, or release URL rather than embedding them.
